recon.notes: Platform: Astro static site (data-astro-cid attributes, /_astro/ assets) rendering posts from a WordPress backend at wp.sf-eagle.com; the events listing is fully static HTML, so the static rung is the scraper's door and no JS rendering is needed. The listing itself states no repeat for any row — the lede says only "Live music, parties, contests and our weekly residents" — and the four cadences come from the home page's residents strip. Read on 2026-09-19: 60 rows, all at the bar (no other venue is named anywhere), 12 titles repeat. Only the four residents the site names with a cadence are folded into series; the other eight repeating titles (Karaoke with Dana ×11, Knotty Bird ×3, Adonis ×3, WOOF! ×3, ScripTease ×3, BLUFSF:HARD ×2, AshHole ×2, KPOC and FOUNDATIONS Social Mixer ×2) have no stated repeat and are documented as singles. Times are printed as "9 PM - 2 AM"; a row whose end is not after its start ends on the following day. The listing has exactly 60 rows and ends with a 3 PM row on Dec 5 while a first-Saturday resident (Filth) would fall that night — treated as a probable row cap and recorded in knownGaps rather than asserted either way.

coverage.basis: All counts come from the configured listing door (https://www.sf-eagle.com/events/), enumerated by script from the saved HTML: 60 event-card anchors, 60 distinct /events/<slug>/ hrefs, 60 distinct (date, title) pairs, month headings SEPTEMBER–DECEMBER 2026. 1 row is dated before the recon date (FRI · SEP 18 Midnights Taylor Swift Dance Party) and is counted as a past listing, not enumerated. The remaining 59 upcoming rows split into 18 rows belonging to the 4 residents whose cadence the home page states (Beer Bust ×10, Queer Leather Happy Hour ×3, Filth ×2, Young Hearts ×3) → 4 series, and 41 rows with no stated repeat → 41 singles. publishedEventCount = 4 + 41 = 45. Every series occurrence is a dated listing row (origin listed); no rule-derived dates are added beyond what the site lists. Second door: the home page's FOLSOM WEEKEND (7) and COMING UP (9) strips are exact subsets of the listing with identical dates and times — zero conflicts. Confidence is medium, not high, because the listing is exactly 60 rows with no completeness signal and the .ics export that would confirm the horizon was not read.
knownGaps: The ICS / Google Calendar export (webcal://wp.sf-eagle.com/events/?ical=1) was seen in the listing footer but not read; whether it carries RRULEs for the residents, more rows past Dec 5, or the same 60 rows is unknown.

The listing is exactly 60 rows and stops at a 3 PM row on Sat Dec 5 with no Filth (a stated 1st-Saturday resident) that night, which reads like a row cap. Nothing after Dec 5 is asserted: Filth Dec 5, Beer Bust Dec 6 / Dec 13, and any further one-offs are not in this file even though they fall inside the occurrence window.

No /events/<slug>/ event page was opened (60 pages, no request budget), so descriptions, cover charges, ticket links, and any per-page recurrence wording are not asserted; expect.extracted is judged on the listing alone.
